title: Fuel System Overhaul Supply
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description_text: Carrier Strike Group Four is seeking information from Contractor personnel that can provide parts for TSV4 Narragansett located at 1570 Gilbert St, Norfolk, VA 23511. The procurement of parts is in support of TSV’s Main Propulsion Generator. The vessel requires overhaul for the optimum operation to ensure the vessel is ready to complete each mission. This combined synopsis will contain a specifications list and will be attached.
